slides.sub: A landmark from 1888, a park from about 1903 and the local library. Swipe for all 3.

slides.title: Butler Museum
slides.body: It's inside Butler's red 1888 train station, now on the State and National Registers of Historic Places. Next open day: Sat., Nov. 21.
slides.source: Borough of Butler, Butler Museum page (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Butler Borough Park
slides.meta: High St to Park Pl, Butler
slides.body: Stone House Brook runs through it, with a footbridge, war memorials, an iron fountain and holiday lights in December.
slides.source: Butler Museum park history; Butler Council minutes (Dec. 2025)

slides.title: Butler Public Library
slides.body: Tuesday story time, toddler time and the Page Turners book club. Check the library calendar before you go.
slides.source: Borough of Butler; Burbio library calendar (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: One Saturday in Butler
slides.tip: The old station is a museum now, so there's no train. Test your rush-hour drive before you offer.
slides.source: Wikipedia, Butler station (NYS&W); Borough of Butler

caption:
Butler's red 1888 train station is now a free museum on Main St, open the 1st and 3rd Saturday of each month, 10 AM to 2 PM. Add the borough park and the library and you've got an easy Saturday. Which stop would you hit first?
